scenes.headline: NOTES INTO A PAPER
scenes.depicts: Turn messy research notes into a paper draft. Meet Paper Orchestra, a multi agent research writing framework.

scenes.headline: START WITH YOUR RESEARCH
scenes.depicts: Give it your ideas, experimental logs, and a LaTeX template.

scenes.headline: A TEAM OF AGENTS
scenes.depicts: Specialist agents build an outline, search related literature, draft sections, and refine the manuscript.

scenes.headline: PLOTS MEET PAPER
scenes.depicts: An optional plotting agent can generate figures. The output is a LaTeX manuscript, ready for you to review.

scenes.headline: CHECK THE WORK
scenes.depicts: You still need to check every claim, citation, and chart. You need model access and API keys, which can cost money.

scenes.headline: YOUR CALL
scenes.depicts: Want the repo? Comment PAPER and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
